title: UAV End-to-End Security Benchmark - Unified Two-Layer Schema v0.1
description: Common schema unifying five UAV security datasets across the network layer (mesh / C2 / bus) and the autonomy layer (GNSS / sensors / controller). Three record kinds: Event (atomic observation), AttackWindow (labeled attack interval), CrossLayerPairing (the novelty: a network attack window paired with an autonomy degradation window and certificate outcome).

Layer.description: Top-level layer. network = anything on the wire/bus/RF-link between nodes; autonomy = anything inside the navigation/perception/control stack.

Sublayer.description: mesh = multi-hop swarm network (UAVIDS-2025, UAV-CAS, DATAMUt). c2_link = ground-to-UAV C2/MAVLink (UAV Attack Dataset). intra_bus = on-board UAVCAN/DroneCAN (HCRL UAVCAN). gnss/sensor/controller/mission = autonomy layer (UAV-EW-Bench).

AttackClass.description: Unified attack taxonomy across all five source datasets. Source-native labels are preserved verbatim in label_native and mapped here.

EventKind.description: flow = aggregated network flow (UAVIDS-2025, UAV-CAS). frame = single bus frame (HCRL UAVCAN). hop = one store-and-forward hop in a DTN/mesh route (DATAMUt). telemetry_sample = one timestamped sensor/telemetry record (UAV Attack Dataset). flight = one whole mission with an outcome (UAV-EW-Bench).

Event.description: One atomic observation, from any source, mapped into common fields. Source-specific extra columns go in `native` untouched.

event_id.description: Globally unique: '<source_dataset>:<native id or row index>'

scenario_id.description: Source scenario/config/topology tag (e.g. DATAMUt 'grid4x4-temporal', UAV-CAS config index, HCRL scenario number).

run_id.description: Seed or repetition identifier within a scenario.

t_start.description: Seconds from the start of the source scenario/capture (relative clock; every source gets its own t=0).

t_end.description: End time in the same relative clock; null for instantaneous events.

src_node.description: Sending/origin entity (UAV id, IP, CAN node id, ground station).

label_native.description: Verbatim label from the source dataset, for provenance.

metrics.description: Small set of cross-source numeric measures; only fill what the source supports.

residual_delay_s.description: DATAMUt: observed minus expected send time at a hop. THE key network-side quantity for the theta->delta mapping.

pos_error_m.description: Position error vs ground truth (UAV Attack Dataset under spoofing; the empirical grounding of delta).

detector.description: Detector verdicts attached to this event (network layer).

operating_point.description: theta: for DATAMUt, the deviation epsilon in seconds.

native.description: All remaining source-native columns, unmodified. Guarantees losslessness.

AttackWindow.description: A labeled attack interval within one source scenario. The unit of cross-layer alignment.

delay_min_s.description: time_delay: injected extra delay range (DATAMUt DelayModel: [1.0, 7.0]).

CrossLayerPairing.description: THE NOVELTY. One record = one composed scenario: a network-layer attack window, the residual (undetected) budget at detector operating point theta, the induced autonomy-layer perturbation delta, and the certified + empirical mission outcome.

pairing_basis.description: Honesty flag. measured_same_platform = network event and autonomy degradation recorded on the same testbed (UAV Attack Dataset). physics_model = coupled through a stated physical model (e.g. delayed C2 correction -> position staleness). synthetic_alignment = time-aligned by construction in simulation.

theta.description: Detector operating point. For DATAMUt: deviation epsilon in seconds.

residual_budget.description: Worst-case attack effect that survives an evading attacker at theta.

undetected_delay_per_hop_s.description: <= theta minus benign floor, per malicious hop.

delta.description: The perturbation budget handed to the certificate engine.

mapping.description: Name/version of the theta->delta mapping used, e.g. 'staleness_v0: delta = v_max * cumulative_delay_s'.

empirical.description: What actually happened, for validating the certificate (empirical MCR must be >= certified floor).
